run_linear_classifier_training: run a linear classifier training on a frozen conv layer using a pretrained model and dataset
run_kfold_cross_validation: run k-fold cross validation for linear classifier training on a supervised dataset
build_RegLog_module: build a logistic regression module on top of frozen convolutional features with average pooling
run_PASCAL_evaluation: run evaluation on the PASCAL VOC2007 dataset using average precision score metrics
run_learning_rate_decay: run inverse square root learning rate decay on an SGD optimizer during training
